title: Button rules follow Apple HIG by role, with glass limited to floating controls
context: Decision 0113 fixed the touch target and placement rules but left list rows on `wide`, kept `sm` and `xs` sizes under 44px, and left the recording panel and chips open. Header, back and close controls were 32px and each page picked its own button size, below HIG's 44pt minimum.
decision: Button sizes are `default`, `lg` and `icon` only. Under `pointer: coarse` all three are 44px tall (`icon` 44x44); under `pointer: fine` `default` is 36, `lg` 40 and `icon` 36x36, with font and padding per size unchanged. `sm`, `xs` and `wide` are removed. The glass shell, without an outline, is a Button variant used only by floating header, back and close controls; other icon actions keep their semantic fills and keyboard focus. Back is always RiArrowLeftSLine and close is always RiCloseLine. A page's primary action and every `type="submit"`, including inside dialogs, use `lg`; an in-section action and AlertDialog confirm and cancel use `default`. Buttons placed side by side share one size and the variant shows importance: `default` or `destructive` for primary, `outline` or `secondary` for secondary. Single-select, immediately applied choices (segmented choice) use `buttonVariants` with `secondary` when unselected and `default` when selected, and expose `aria-pressed` or the radio semantics already provided. The navigation FAB and the landing CTAButton keep their own sizes. No lint enforces size rules because the role classification is a semantic judgement guarded by DESIGN.md and review.

alternatives.reason: Dense desktop layouts need compact hit areas, hence the `pointer: fine` sizes.
They fall below the touch target and let each page pick its own size; role-based `default` and `lg` are enough.

alternatives.option: Add a lint rule for size by role
alternatives.reason: The role of a button is a semantic judgement a rule cannot decide, so a rule would produce false confidence.

consequences: Every `sm` and `xs` caller moves to `default`; later work migrates the remaining action sizes, header and close controls, and segmented choices.
Dialog header controls and page layouts need re-checking at the 44px size.
Decision 0113 is superseded; its still-valid rules are restated here.
revisitTriggers: A role appears that neither `default` nor `lg` fits.
